questions.stem: Which one of the following statements is correct regarding chronic granulomatous disease-

options.label: A
options.text: It is an autosomal dominant disease

options.label: B
options.text: It is characterised by abnormal bacterial phagocytosis

options.label: C
options.text: Recurrent streptococcal infections are usual in this disease

options.label: D
options.text: Nitroblue-tetrazolium test is helpful for screening

questions.answerText: Nitroblue-tetrazolium test is helpful for screening
questions.solutionHtml:
Nitroblue-tetrazolium test is helpful for screening

Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 241, 344

questions.stemHtml: A 25-year-old male presented with fever and malaise for the last 15 days. A 2x2cm cervical node was palpable, the biopsy of which has been shown below. Identify the lesion?
questions.solutionHtml:
Tubercular granuloma
  • History is classical of TB: young adult, with fever, malaise, cervical LN.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 100

Cat-scratch disease
  • Stellate granuloma is seen in Cat-scratch disease.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 98, 101
